label: maps to role
type: subject = an EXTERNAL identity construct (an LDAP group, a SAML attribute); object = the Couchbase Server group or RBAC role its members acquire. The federation boundary crossing.
note: Distinct from the promoted Capella data-plane family (grantsRole, assignsRole, groupMembersInheritRole), all of which have a Couchbase-side subject: this one's subject is defined in a system Couchbase does not control, which is exactly the property that makes external-identity configuration hard to reason about. Two files, LDAP and SAML, arriving at the same shape independently - and both of them route through a Couchbase GROUP rather than granting a role directly, which is the part of the mechanism the role catalogue cannot show.
relates_to_competency_question: How does membership of an external directory group become a Couchbase role?
